lines.zh: 我贴着礁石游，红鳞在暗水里很显眼。
lines.en: I skim the reef, my red scales loud in the dim water.

lines.zh: 三条同伴跟着我，绕过同一块珊瑚。
lines.en: Three schoolmates follow me around the same coral head.

lines.zh: 近岸的水浅，我游得很稳很慢。
lines.en: The nearshore water is shallow; I swim steady and slow.

lines.zh: 我从礁缝里穿过去，尾巴扫起细沙。
lines.en: I slip through a reef gap, tail lifting fine sand.

lines.zh: 我沿着海底的坡往上走一点。
lines.en: I work my way a little up the seabed slope.

lines.zh: 五条红影一起拐弯，像有人喊了口令。
lines.en: Five red shapes turn at once, as if given an order.

lines.zh: 水面在头顶晃，我在下面走自己的线。
lines.en: The surface sways overhead; I keep my own line below.

lines.zh: 我绕礁石转了一圈，又回到原处。
lines.en: I circle the reef once and come back to where I was.

lines.zh: 海流推我，我侧身顶住它。
lines.en: The current pushes me; I turn my flank into it.

lines.zh: 我游过一片白沙，红得几乎刺眼。
lines.en: I cross a patch of white sand, almost painfully red.

lines.zh: 顺着礁底的石沟，我一路往下。
lines.en: Along the reef's stone gutter, I work my way down.

lines.zh: 我贴着珊瑚走，尽量不碰它。
lines.en: I travel close to the coral, trying not to touch it.

lines.zh: 同伴散开又聚回来，队形松了。
lines.en: The school spreads and closes again, loose in shape.

lines.zh: 深一点的水里，我的红看着像褐色。
lines.en: In deeper water my red looks almost brown.

lines.zh: 我从石缝里穿出来，红尾一晃。
lines.en: Out of a rock crack, tail flashing red.

lines.zh: 水面上的船影让我往下沉。
lines.en: A boat's shadow sends me deeper.

lines.zh: 我咬了一口礁上的藻，又吐了。
lines.en: I bite the reef weed and spit it out.

lines.zh: 我们排队从船锚边绕过去。
lines.en: We file past the anchor in a line.

lines.zh: 我悬在礁石上方，慢慢摆着尾。
lines.en: I hover above the reef, waving my tail slowly.

lines.zh: 阳光落到海底，我在光斑边上停住。
lines.en: Sunlight reaches the floor; I stop at its edge.

lines.zh: 我躲进珊瑚的影子里，红就暗了。
lines.en: I slip into the coral's shade and my red dims.

lines.zh: 周围没什么动静，我把嘴张得很小。
lines.en: Nothing stirs nearby, so I open my mouth barely.

lines.zh: 我靠着礁石，身体几乎不动。
lines.en: I lean against the reef, my body almost still.

lines.zh: 四条同伴停在下面，一起悬着。
lines.en: Four schoolmates wait below, all hanging still.

lines.zh: 我听见海底有细碎的咔嚓声。
lines.en: I hear a small crunching from the seabed.

lines.zh: 潮水换了方向，我转了个身。
lines.en: The tide turns and I turn with it.

lines.zh: 我把鳍全摊开，任水流过去。
lines.en: I spread all my fins and let the current pass.

lines.zh: 礁缝里冒出一串小泡，我看着它们升。
lines.en: A string of bubbles leaves a gap; I watch them rise.

lines.zh: 我停得太久，尾巴都有点僵。
lines.en: I have stayed so long my tail feels stiff.

lines.zh: 那条大鱼走远了，我才敢放松。
lines.en: The big fish moves off and only then do I relax.

lines.zh: 我贴近沙底，把红藏进褐色里。
lines.en: I sink to the sand and hide my red in brown.

lines.zh: 海面很平，我在下面一动不动。
lines.en: The sea surface is flat; I lie still beneath it.

lines.zh: 你在礁石上方，我一抬头就看见。
lines.en: You are above the reef; one glance and I see you.

lines.zh: 我躲在珊瑚后面，只露出半条红身。
lines.en: I hide behind coral with half my red body showing.

lines.zh: 你的影子压到海底，我立刻转身。
lines.en: Your shadow presses on the floor and I turn at once.

lines.zh: 我围着礁石绕，总让石头挡在你那边。
lines.en: I circle the reef, always keeping stone between us.

lines.zh: 我在你下方三格处停住，看着你的脚。
lines.en: I stop three blocks under you and watch your feet.

lines.zh: 你一动，红鳞就跟着反了一下光。
lines.en: You move and my red scales flash once in reply.

lines.zh: 我从礁缝里探出头，看你在做什么。
lines.en: I poke out of a gap to see what you are doing.

lines.zh: 我认得你手里的线，比认得你更快。
lines.en: I know the line in your hand sooner than I know you.

lines.zh: 我顺着你的影子游了半圈。
lines.en: I swim half a circle along your shadow.

lines.zh: 你没动，我就一直不上来。
lines.en: You stay still, so I stay down.

lines.zh: 血一散开，周围的红都变了。
lines.en: Blood spreads and all the nearby red changes.

lines.zh: 鳞被削掉一片，露出白肉。
lines.en: A scale is shaved off, showing white flesh.

lines.zh: 我往礁缝里钻，撞了两下才进去。
lines.en: I dive for a reef gap and hit it twice.

lines.zh: 这伤让我游得歪了一点。
lines.en: The wound makes me swim a little crooked.

lines.zh: 我疼得贴着海底，不敢抬高。
lines.en: Pain keeps me low against the seabed.

lines.zh: 同伴散开，只剩我一条红影。
lines.en: The school scatters, leaving one red shape.

lines.zh: 水里的血味把别的鱼引来了。
lines.en: The blood in the water draws other fish.

lines.zh: 我咬紧牙，把尾巴摆得更快。
lines.en: I clench my jaw and beat my tail faster.

lines.zh: 撞伤的地方一跳一跳地疼。
lines.en: The bruised spot throbs with every beat.

lines.zh: 我退了很远，才敢停下来。
lines.en: I retreat a long way before daring to stop.

lines.zh: 那股腥味一沉下来，我就往上凑。
lines.en: That bloody smell sinks down and I drift up to it.

lines.zh: 钩上的虾在动，我看着它的须。
lines.en: The shrimp on the hook moves; I watch its feelers.

lines.zh: 我绕着饵转，先试了三次。
lines.en: I circle the bait three times, testing it first.

lines.zh: 红光在水里一闪，我以为是同伴。
lines.en: A red flash in the water; I think it a schoolmate.

lines.zh: 我张嘴时，那点味道刚好被吞进去。
lines.en: I open my mouth and the taste slides right in.

lines.zh: 我知道钩在饵里，可我还是饿。
lines.en: I know the hook is in the bait, but I am hungry.

lines.zh: 同伴咬过一口，我就跟着上去了。
lines.en: A schoolmate takes a bite, and up I go too.

lines.zh: 那根线绷了一下，我的尾巴也绷了。
lines.en: The line tightens and my tail tightens with it.

lines.zh: 我贴着饵闻，闻到的是铁。
lines.en: I sniff the bait close and smell iron.

lines.zh: 我咬住时，海水忽然变轻了。
lines.en: When I bite, the seawater suddenly feels lighter.

lines.zh: 我撞上珊瑚，红鳞掉了几片。
lines.en: I hit the coral and lose a few red scales.

lines.zh: 你伸手下来，我撞在你掌心。
lines.en: You reach down and I butt into your palm.

lines.zh: 礁石太窄，我侧着身才挤过去。
lines.en: The reef gap is narrow; I squeeze through sideways.

lines.zh: 同伴的鳍打到我，我们一起转了向。
lines.en: A schoolmate's fin slaps me and we both turn.

lines.zh: 我撞到你的靴边，被弹了回来。
lines.en: I strike your boot and get bounced back.

lines.zh: 这一下撞在腹上，我停了半晌。
lines.en: The blow lands on my belly and I stop a while.

lines.zh: 我贴着桶底滑，鳞片刮出声音。
lines.en: I slide along the bucket floor, scales scraping.

lines.zh: 我往后退，又撞上了另一块礁。
lines.en: I retreat and hit another piece of reef.

lines.zh: 水里全是沙子，我睁不开眼。
lines.en: The water fills with sand and I cannot open my eyes.

lines.zh: 它撞我，我就撞回去，只一下。
lines.en: It bumps me and I bump back, just once.

lines.zh: 我的红比平时更亮，那是信号。
lines.en: My red is brighter than usual; that is the signal.

lines.zh: 我绕着她转，把侧身让给她看。
lines.en: I circle her and show her my bright flank.

lines.zh: 两条红影并排，贴着礁底慢慢升。
lines.en: Two red shapes rise slowly side by side.

lines.zh: 我用鳍碰她一下，她没有躲。
lines.en: I touch her with a fin and she does not flinch.

lines.zh: 我们把卵放在礁石背流的一面。
lines.en: We lay our eggs on the reef's sheltered side.

lines.zh: 别的雄鱼靠过来，我就横身挡着。
lines.en: When another male nears, I block him broadside.

lines.zh: 海流把卵带走一点，我跟过去。
lines.en: The current carries some eggs off; I follow them.

lines.zh: 我们并排守了整片礁底。
lines.en: Together we guard the whole reef floor.

lines.zh: 她先游开，我在后面慢慢跟。
lines.en: She swims off first and I trail slowly after.

lines.zh: 红色的两条，在礁影里合成一条。
lines.en: Two red fish merge into one in the reef's shadow.

lines.zh: 桶里水少，我只能侧着躺。
lines.en: With little water in the bucket, I lie on my side.

lines.zh: 我撞着桶壁，红鳞在桶里很亮。
lines.en: I knock the bucket wall; my red scales glow inside.

lines.zh: 桶一晃，我就顺着水流转。
lines.en: The bucket sways and I turn with the water.

lines.zh: 你把我拎起来，海水从缝里漏光。
lines.en: You lift me and seawater leaks out through the gap.

lines.zh: 我在桶底听着，外面很吵。
lines.en: I listen from the bucket floor; outside is loud.

lines.zh: 从礁石到岸上，我一路都醒着。
lines.en: From reef to shore, I stay awake the whole way.

lines.zh: 桶里的水只到我背的一半。
lines.en: The bucket water reaches only half my back.

lines.zh: 我倒进新水，先沉到最下面。
lines.en: Poured into new water, I sink to the very bottom.

lines.zh: 你打开盖子时，我正好抬头。
lines.en: When you open the lid, I happen to look up.

lines.zh: 我知道自己回不去那片礁了。
lines.en: I know I will not return to that reef.

lines.zh: 礁边有水纹乱动，我先把头压低。
lines.en: Ripples churn by the reef; I lower my head first.

lines.zh: 谁靠得太近，我就先记住它的颜色。
lines.en: Whoever comes too close, I remember its color first.

lines.zh: 一线血味从上面下来，我抬了头。
lines.en: A thread of blood drifts down and I look up.

lines.zh: 那团影子不像同伴，我盯住了。
lines.en: That shape is no schoolmate; I fix on it.

lines.zh: 我把身子转正，对准那点动静。
lines.en: I square my body toward the small disturbance.

lines.zh: 目标比我的嘴大，我还是选了它。
lines.en: The target is bigger than my mouth; I choose it anyway.

lines.zh: 我贴着礁底绕，尽量不出水纹。
lines.en: I slide along the reef floor, making no ripple.

lines.zh: 有一条小的落在后面，我就找它。
lines.en: One small fish lags behind, so I go for it.

lines.zh: 我认得出鱼和竿影的区别。
lines.en: I can tell a fish from the shadow of a rod.

lines.zh: 决定只用了一下，然后我就冲。
lines.en: The decision takes one instant, then I charge.

lines.zh: 我沿着礁壁跟上，角度一直没变。
lines.en: I follow along the reef wall, the angle unchanged.

lines.zh: 它往上，我就不跟上去，只等。
lines.en: It rises; I do not follow, I only wait.

lines.zh: 我把距离压在两步之内。
lines.en: I keep the distance inside two body lengths.

lines.zh: 它回头看，我停在珊瑚后面。
lines.en: It looks back; I stop behind the coral.

lines.zh: 我的红太亮，我尽量贴住暗处。
lines.en: My red is too bright, so I keep to the dark.

lines.zh: 它慢下来，我的尾也慢下来。
lines.en: It slows, and my tail slows with it.

lines.zh: 我绕着圈靠近，一圈比一圈小。
lines.en: I close in circles, each one smaller than the last.

lines.zh: 它钻礁缝，我就在外面等。
lines.en: It dives into a gap; I wait outside.

lines.zh: 我盯住它的鳃盖，那处动得最快。
lines.en: I watch its gill cover, the fastest-moving part.

lines.zh: 到最后，我只剩一个方向。
lines.en: By the end, only one direction is left to me.

lines.zh: 我一口咬在它鳃后，往礁上撞。
lines.en: I bite behind its gills and ram it into the reef.

lines.zh: 我的牙不够长，只能撕开一点。
lines.en: My teeth are short; I can only tear a little.

lines.zh: 我用整个身子压住它，不给它转身。
lines.en: I pin it with my whole body so it cannot turn.

lines.zh: 它挣得很凶，我的红鳞被刮花。
lines.en: It fights hard and my red scales get scratched.

lines.zh: 我撞它侧腹，撞了两下才停。
lines.en: I ram its flank twice before I stop.

lines.zh: 沙被我们搅起来，礁底看不清了。
lines.en: We stir up sand until the reef floor is blind.

lines.zh: 它咬我，我就绕到它上面去。
lines.en: It bites me, so I slip above it.

lines.zh: 我咬住它的鳍，让它跑不快。
lines.en: I clamp its fin so it cannot swim fast.

lines.zh: 我咬住它的尾，往礁石拖。
lines.en: I bite its tail and drag it toward the reef.

lines.zh: 打完了，我红得更显眼。
lines.en: When it ends, my red stands out more.

lines.zh: 我从礁石的暗面出现，红先亮起来。
lines.en: I appear from the reef's dark side, red first.

lines.zh: 四条同伴已经绕成一圈，我补进去。
lines.en: Four schoolmates already circle; I join the ring.

lines.zh: 海水很浅，我一出生就看见光。
lines.en: The sea is shallow; I see light at birth.

lines.zh: 我先学会的是贴着礁走。
lines.en: The first thing I learn is to hug the reef.

lines.zh: 岸不远，我能听见上面的声音。
lines.en: The shore is near; I hear sounds from above.

lines.zh: 我从珊瑚缝里钻出来，身上还带沙。
lines.en: I emerge from a coral gap still dusty with sand.

lines.zh: 这一片礁底，今天多了一条红鲷。
lines.en: This reef floor gains one more red snapper.

lines.zh: 我摆第一下尾，就跟着群走了。
lines.en: With my first tailbeat I follow the school.

lines.zh: 海流把我推了一点，我没退。
lines.en: The current shoves me a little; I do not give.

lines.zh: 我出生在礁影里，那里最安全。
lines.en: I am born in the reef's shadow, the safest place.

lines.zh: 火先烧掉红鳞，鱼肉才变白。
lines.en: Fire burns away the red scales before the flesh whitens.

lines.zh: 被甩上岸，我在石头上拍着尾。
lines.en: Flung ashore, I slap my tail against the stone.

lines.zh: 我嘴里全是沙，水也咽不下去。
lines.en: My mouth fills with sand and I cannot swallow water.

lines.zh: 爆风把整片礁底掀了起来。
lines.en: The blast lifts the whole reef floor.

lines.zh: 箭射进水里，从我背鳍边穿过去。
lines.en: An arrow enters the water and passes my dorsal fin.

lines.zh: 紫色的光碰到鳞，红变成了黑。
lines.en: Purple light touches my scales and red turns black.

lines.zh: 饿的时候，我连珊瑚上的苔都舔。
lines.en: When starved, I lick the moss off the coral.

lines.zh: 雷打进海里，我的骨头都亮了。
lines.en: Lightning enters the sea and lights my bones.

lines.zh: 脚下的礁忽然没了，我一沉到底。
lines.en: The reef beneath vanishes and I sink through.
